annotations.title: Parking space prices from developer price lists (dane.gov.pl)

description: Use for the price of a parking space, a garage space or a storage room from developers in a Polish city, and how it compares with the price of 1 m2 of a new flat. Say that these are asking prices from developer price lists and give the week. Asking prices of parking spaces sold by housing developers in Poland, from the daily price-list files on dane.gov.pl (act on transparency of new-flat prices). Weekly median, quartiles and counts of single parking spaces for Poland and cities above the publication threshold, underground or garage-hall vs outdoor vs garage, storage rooms and bike boxes, how many square metres of a new flat in the same city one space costs, change vs 4 weeks earlier and a weekly trend. Finwire index finwire_dev_parking_price.

city.description: City name or slug (Warszawa, zielona-gora). Default: Poland with the city list.

weeks.description: Number of past weeks in the trend, default 12.
